title: Finish the ACT's switch from conveyance duty to rates
action: Complete the scheduled phase-out of conveyance duty and keep funding it through general rates on land, without new transaction taxes.
why: The ACT is the only Australian government replacing stamp duty across the board. Finishing it removes the tax on moving entirely and shows other states the path.

evidence.source: Australia's Future Tax System: Report to the Treasurer, Part One (Henry review)
evidence.quote: Increasing land tax at the same time as reducing stamp duty has the additional benefit of some offsetting impacts on asset prices.

evidence.source: Shifting the Dial: 5 Year Productivity Review
evidence.quote: Phase out stamp duties on residential and commercial property transfers and replace them with a broad-based tax based on unimproved land value. Transition over several years to aid adjustment.
